visualize_hitl_episodes: generate MP4 videos of HITL episode rollouts by running the script with --episodes-path and --dataset-file arguments
load_metadata: load object and receptacle metadata from CSV files into a merged pandas DataFrame with handle and type columns
get_object_property_from_metadata: query the semantic type or other property of an object by its handle from loaded metadata
get_furniture_property_from_metadata: query the semantic type or other property of a furniture item by its handle from loaded metadata
batch_process_session_file: process multiple HITL episode files in parallel using multiprocessing to generate visualization videos
